procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide, a first base, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol are charged into a reaction flask and reacted below the stated ceiling temperature until LC shows complete conversion, then filtered, washed with water and concentrated. A second base and water are added to the residue and the ester is hydrolysed under alkali below the same ceiling, and after LC shows completion hydrochloric acid is added dropwise to acidify; filtration, washing and drying give the benzoic acid.
notes: PROSE step. Heading [0015] line 121: 2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成. ONE-POT, with the qualification stated here in full. The step runs two transformations, a Williamson-type etherification of the benzylic bromide with 2,2,2-三氟乙醇 and then an alkaline hydrolysis of the methyl ester, and it isolates nothing between them: the ether ester is never named and the material is carried forward only as 剩余物 (the residue). It is not a clean one-pot, however, because 反应完毕后过滤，有机层水洗，浓缩 sits between the two transformations, which is a genuine workup and not merely a solvent exchange. is_one_pot is set true on the ground that no intermediate is isolated or named, and the intervening filtration, water wash and concentration are recorded verbatim in workup.steps so that a reader can take the other view. reaction_class is taken from the final transformation, the alkaline hydrolysis, per the one-pot rule. ACIDIFICATION IS RECORDED AS WORKUP, NOT AS A THIRD TRANSFORMATION: 滴加盐酸酸化 is followed immediately by 过滤，洗涤，烘干, so it is the isolation of the free acid from its salt rather than a step of the synthesis, and it therefore appears in workup rather than in one_pot_steps. No pH number is given anywhere, so ph_value, ph_target_stage and workup.ph_target are all left null. TEMPERATURE: [0016] states 在80℃以下 separately for the etherification and for the 碱解, and [0024] gives 反应温度为0～80℃ for step 2) without saying which of the two stages it governs. The range 0～80℃ is carried in conditions.temperature and both statements are recorded here. No time is given for either stage. PLACEHOLDERS: the step charges 碱1, 催化剂 and 溶剂 as generic labels. [0023] states 所述碱1为碳酸钾, gives the catalyst as 三乙烯二胺 or 2-甲基三乙烯二胺, and permits 氢氧化钠, 氢氧化钾 or 氢氧化锂 for 碱2; [0024] permits 乙腈, DMF, 丙酮 or 四氢呋喃 as solvent, all aprotic polar. Each enumerated member is its own A1 record; what this step charges is the placeholder, so the placeholder is what is recorded. catalyst_class:base is tagged because both permitted catalysts are tertiary amines and 碱1 is a carbonate. WATER: recorded as a reactant rather than as a wash, because [0016] charges it to the residue together with 碱2 as the medium of the 碱解; the earlier 有机层水洗 use of water is carried in workup.washes. NAMED REACTION: null. The first transformation is a Williamson ether synthesis and that is recorded on Scheme Step 2, whose class is the etherification; this record is classed as the hydrolysis, so putting a name for the other transformation on it would misread the field. FLAG reagent_written_not_drawn: the step charges a 催化剂, identified by [0023] as 三乙烯二胺 or 2-甲基三乙烯二胺, and arrow 2 of the scheme at line 152 is completely bare, carrying no label above or below it. The catalyst of this step is therefore on no arrow anywhere in the drawing. The generic 溶剂 is likewise undrawn but is not counted, on the same policy applied throughout this section. DRAWING OTHERWISE AGREES: the drawing splits this step across arrows 2 and 3, drawing the ether ester that the prose never names, and arrow 3 carries the label 碱/酸, which matches the prose pairing of 碱2 with the subsequent 盐酸 acidification. That is a granularity difference, not a disagreement about chemistry, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised. ARITHMETIC: no mass, volume, mole or yield anywhere, only the ratio ranges of [0022], so nothing can be checked and no arithmetic flag is available.

procedure_text: 将2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、催化剂、氯化亚砜、溶剂加入反应瓶，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂；将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶，在30℃以下滴加三乙胺，LC跟踪至反应完全；反应完全后，加入丙酮氰醇，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得米黄色固体环磺酮。
procedure_summary: The benzoic acid, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent are charged into a reaction flask and reacted at reflux, after which the solvent is stripped off completely. 1,3-Cyclohexanedione and solvent are then charged, triethylamine is added dropwise below the stated ceiling temperature and the reaction is followed by LC to completion; acetone cyanohydrin is then added and the reaction again followed by LC to completion. Water is added for a water wash, the layers are separated, the oil layer is stripped of solvent, and recrystallisation, filtration and drying give tembotrione as a beige solid.
notes: PROSE step. Heading [0017] line 125: 3)环磺酮的合成. ONE-POT across three transformations with nothing isolated between them: the acid chloride is made and the solvent stripped (脱尽溶剂) but the acid chloride is never named as a compound and never worked up, the 1,3-环己二酮 and fresh solvent are charged into 反应瓶 on top of that residue, and the enol ester formed on adding 三乙胺 is likewise never named and never isolated before 丙酮氰醇 is added to it. reaction_class is taken from the final transformation, the conversion of the enol ester to the 2-aroyl-1,3-cyclohexanedione, which is an acylation of carbon. The acid chloride and the enol ester get no compound records here because the prose names neither; the acid chloride does appear as a drawn structure and is recorded on Scheme Step 4 and Scheme Step 5 under the SMILES identifier A1 gave it. NAMED REACTION: null. The 丙酮氰醇 stage is a cyanide-promoted migration of the acyl group from oxygen to carbon, often called a Fries-type rearrangement, but the classical Fries rearrangement is an aromatic ester reaction promoted by a Lewis acid and applying that name here would be a stretch, so it is left null and described instead. MECHANISM: ionic. 丙酮氰醇 is charged at 0.01～0.1 relative to the acid per [0025], so it is plainly sub-stoichiometric and acts as a cyanide source rather than as a stoichiometric reagent, but A1 records its role as reagent because the section never calls it 催化剂, and that role is kept here. catalyst_class is skipped: the tag vocabulary has no value for the 催化剂 of this step, which [0027] identifies as DMF acting as a nucleophilic catalyst in the acid chloride formation, and none for a cyanohydrin cyanide source. TEMPERATURE: the step has two different thermal regimes and the conditions block holds one. 升温回流反应 is recorded as heating_method reflux with temperature left unset by it, because 回流 is a heating method and not a temperature. The only numeric temperature the step states is the 三乙胺 dropwise addition, 在30℃以下 in [0018] and 0～30℃ in [0026], and that range is what conditions.temperature carries; the dropwise character is on the triethylamine's addition_profile. No temperature is given for the 丙酮氰醇 stage and none has been inferred. No time is given for any of the three transformations. SOLVENT: charged three times as the placeholder 溶剂, and the reaction solvent of step 3) is enumerated nowhere in this section, so solvent_class is skipped rather than guessed; only the crystallisation solvent is enumerated, at [0027]. CONCENTRATION: 脱尽溶剂 twice, with no 减压 anywhere, so pressure stays not_specified. FLAG reagent_written_not_drawn: the step charges a 催化剂 which [0027] identifies as DMF, and DMF appears at no position on the drawn scheme; arrow 5, which is where the acid chloride is formed and where that catalyst belongs, is completely bare. The generic 溶剂 is also undrawn but is not counted, on the policy applied throughout this section. DRAWING OTHERWISE AGREES, AND SPLITS THE STEP: the drawing renders this one numbered step as two arrows, arrow 5 for the acid chloride formation and arrow 4 for the acylation of the dione, and it prints arrow 4 above arrow 5, so the drawn order is the reverse of the chemical order. That is a granularity difference plus a layout inversion, not a disagreement about chemistry, so no drawing_text_conflict is raised; see Scheme Step 4 and Scheme Step 5. Arrow 4's label 三乙胺/丙酮氰醇 and arrow 5's co-reactant 氯化亚砜 both match this prose exactly, as does the 1,3 substitution of the drawn dione. SAFETY: safety_notes is empty because this section states no hazard about any reagent. 丙酮氰醇 is a cyanide source and the safety tag vocabulary has a cyanide_handling value, but the tag is skipped and no hazard is asserted, because the assessment belongs to A5 and the text supports none. ARITHMETIC: no mass, volume, mole or yield anywhere, only the six-component ratio ranges of [0025], so nothing can be checked and no arithmetic flag is available. The isolated solid is described only as 米黄色固体 with no purity and no analytics beyond the two LC checks.
